purpose: Teach: 王者/焦り/断る/発散/流用/取り残さ/風情/跡地

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、業界の王者、独占の構造、論じましたね。
lines.en: Your paper covered the industry leader and monopoly structures well.
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Steady pace. Gentle affirmation—noticing the work without overdoing it. Professional but human.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。焦りで失敗した経営判断、章にしました。
lines.en: Yes. I made that into a chapter—the management decisions that panicked under pressure.
lines.style: Focused, almost matter-of-fact. Light self-awareness in the delivery. Not defensive, just precise. A student clarifying his own thinking aloud.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 招待を断る勇気、研究者にも必要ですね。
lines.en: The courage to turn down opportunities—that's something researchers need too.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Slight lean forward. Recognition that this matters. Not lecturing—observing something true they both understand.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。情報を発散する場、メディア、検討しました。
lines.en: Yes. I looked at where that information goes—media outlets, how they handle it.
lines.style: Methodical, slightly hesitant—thinking as he speaks. Careful not to overstate. The tone of someone walking through their own research step by step.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 予算流用、業界の闇、扱いましたか。
lines.en: And the budget misuse—the darker side of the industry. You addressed that?
lines.style: Measured, genuinely curious. A slight uptick at the end—not skeptical, checking in. Quiet authority that comes from actually knowing the field.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。被災者が取り残されない社会、目指す、と書きました。
lines.en: Yes. I wrote about it in terms of building a society where disaster victims aren't left behind.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. The words come slower because they carry weight. Not dramatic—sincere. This is what the research was actually for.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 風情ある研究テーマ、章末で言及しましたね。
lines.en: And you mentioned those atmospheric research themes at the end of the chapter.
lines.style: Approving nod in the voice. Recognition of craft—how he framed it. Warm, specific. She's reading between his lines and liking what she sees.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 廃工場の跡地、再開発、最終章で論じました。
lines.en: Right. The abandoned factory site—I analyzed the redevelopment plan in my final chapter.
lines.style: Conclusion-level steadiness. Slight closure in the pacing. He's brought the whole thing together. Quiet confidence, no flourish. The work speaks.
